extraction.Name: Jack Lavern Bonser
extraction.Refused/Protested: I do not remember for sure but do remember stating that I did not apply for it.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged then sold it.
extraction.NOTES: Allottee was going to the Army in 15 days at time of sale; stated he did not apply for patent; received $800 before he left and wife received $500.00; no debts settled in the sale; has four children; in good health; patent received at Rosebud Agency; document subscribed and sworn before S. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on the 27th day of March 1929.
